material_warnings: The authority is discretionary; the Act does not mandate design-build adoption.
The Act creates no appropriation or project pipeline.
Municipal and school provisions are legally separate and differ at the exact $12 million threshold.

The ordinary municipal Phase II shortlist remains two to six entities, but P.A. 104-0395 permits evaluation of a sole Phase I respondent when the municipality, in its discretion, finds proceeding to be in its best interest.
Pre-RFP opportunity signals are investigative hypotheses unless expressly required by the Act.
Conflict and early-contact questions are fact-specific and may require Illinois procurement counsel.
